title: dbt-ci configuration
description: Configuration file for dbt-ci. Supports nested style (recommended) and flat legacy DBT_* style. Hyphens and underscores are interchangeable in key names. Precedence: CLI flag > config file > environment variable > default.

profiles.description: Named sets of settings, selected with --profile (or DBT_CI_PROFILE) and applied over the top-level settings. A profile takes the same keys as the top level, except 'profiles'. Commands after init reuse the profile init ran with.

on.description: Settings per CI event, applied over the top-level settings and the selected profile: 'pull-request' for pull/merge request runs, 'push' for pushes to the default branch, or to the branches 'push.branches' lists, 'schedule' for scheduled runs, whatever branch they run on. The event is detected from the CI system, or set with --event (DBT_CI_EVENT). Each takes the same keys as the top level, except 'profiles' and 'on'.

docker.description: Docker runner configuration. Only used when runner is 'docker'.

env.description: Environment variables to inject into the container in 'KEY=VALUE' format.

user.description: User (UID:GID) to run as inside the container.

args.description: Additional arguments to pass to 'docker run'.

filters.description: Only run the tests that depend on one of these resource types.

retries.description: Retry a failed step up to this many times with 'dbt retry', which reruns only the nodes that errored, failed or were skipped (default: 0).

files.description: Files to upload during finalize (default: manifest).

notifications.description: Where and how dbt-ci sends notifications.

review.description: Options for the 'dbt-ci review' command, which reviews the changed models with Claude. Needs 'pip install dbt-ci[ai]' and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Only SQL and metadata are sent, never warehouse data.

model.description: Claude model that reviews the changes.

effort.description: How hard the model thinks about each batch of models.

exclude.description: Leave out models whose path matches these patterns, e.g. 'models/legacy/*'.

instructions.description: Extra guidance for the reviewer, such as your team's conventions.

output.description: Where to write the review. Defaults to stdout; 'dbt-ci report' shows it either way.

reviewMaxModels.description: Review at most this many changed models; the ones with the longest recorded run time are kept.

reviewFailOn.description: Exit 1 when a finding is at least this severe.

reviewDryRun.description: List the models the review would send, without calling Claude. Overrides the top-level dry-run for review.

pushBranches.description: Only valid under on.push (top level or a profile's). The branches a push deploys from: names or fnmatch-style patterns, where '*' matches any characters including '/' (so 'release/*' also matches 'release/1.2/hotfix'), '?' one character and '[...]' a set; matching is case-sensitive. A push counts when its branch matches any of them; without this list, only a push to the default branch counts. A profile's own list replaces the top-level one. Not a setting: it is not passed to any command.

projectDir.description: Path to the dbt project directory.

profilesDir.description: Path to the directory containing profiles.yml.

state.description: Local path where the reference manifest.json is stored or downloaded to.

target.description: The dbt target to use. Defaults to the target defined in profiles.yml.

vars.description: A YAML string or path to a YAML file containing variables to pass to dbt.

runner.description: Runner to use for executing dbt commands.

adapter.description: The dbt adapter to use (e.g. bigquery, postgres, snowflake).

dbtVersion.description: Pin a specific dbt version (e.g. 1.10.13, or 2.0.9 for dbt v2). Requires runner 'local'.

dbtSelectors.description: dbt selectors (e.g. tag:ci_skip), as a list or a space-separated string.

downstreamDepth.description: How many levels of downstream dependencies to include (default: full graph).

skipTestOnlyChanges.description: Don't rebuild a model, seed or snapshot when only its tests changed; run just the changed tests.

reportOutput.description: Where to write the report (defaults to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY when set, otherwise stdout).

dryRun.description: Print commands without executing them, for every command. delete, migration and ephemeral read their own dry-run key (e.g. delete.dry-run) first.

quiet.description: Run in quiet mode with minimal output.

notificationsProvider.description: Service the notification webhook belongs to.

prComment.description: Make 'dbt-ci report' also post the report as a comment on the GitHub pull request, updating it on later runs. Needs GITHUB_TOKEN with 'pull-requests: write'.

notificationsFormat.description: Layout of the notification: 'default' lists changed nodes by name, 'compact' sends only the counts, 'json' sends the unique_ids as a JSON code block.

shellPath.description: Path to the shell executable. Only used when runner is 'bash'.

referenceTarget.description: The dbt target to use for the reference/production manifest.

referenceVars.description: Variables to pass to dbt when compiling the reference manifest.

stateUri.description: Remote URI for the state manifest.json (e.g. gs://bucket/manifest.json).

referencePath.description: Output path when compiling with reference vars.

targetCompile.description: Compile towards the target (or default) after reference compile.

skipReferenceCompile.description: Skip compiling towards the reference state.

compareTo.description: What to compare the pull request against: auto (the merge base when the branch has commits of its own, else the latest state), merge-base, or latest.

baseRef.description: Base branch to diff against (e.g. main). Auto-detected from git/CI env if not set. Overrides GITHUB_BASE_REF and git auto-detection.

artifactsUri.description: Object storage URI for storing artifacts (e.g. s3://bucket/dbt-artifacts/). {pr} and {branch} are replaced with the pull request number and the branch (with characters other than letters, digits, ., _ and - replaced by -), e.g. gs://bucket/dbt-ci-prs/{pr}/.

forceManifest.description: Replace the published manifest.json even when it was built from a newer commit than this run's, e.g. to roll back.

cleanEphemeral.description: Deprecated - use 'dbt-ci ephemeral destroy'. Drop the datasets 'ephemeral' cloned into when finalizing.

keepEnv.description: Deprecated - has no effect. Use 'dbt-ci ephemeral destroy' to tear the environment down.

deleteDryRun.description: Only list the relations 'dbt-ci delete' would drop. Applies to delete alone, and wins over the top-level dry-run; --dry-run on the command line wins over both.

migrationDryRun.description: Only list the tables and statements 'dbt-ci migration' would run. Applies to migration alone, and wins over the top-level dry-run; --dry-run on the command line wins over both.

ephemeralDryRun.description: Only print what 'dbt-ci ephemeral create' would clone and 'ephemeral destroy' would drop. Applies to those commands alone, and wins over the top-level dry-run; --dry-run on the command line wins over both.
